decisions.reason: As a low-cost digital add-on that supports data quality and fits the platform direction, it is likely to be retained unless its results clearly miss aspirations, and the expanding firm appears to have enough slack to wait.

This database is close to the core regulated-energy data business, so its strategic fit and reuse of existing data capabilities make retention more likely unless demand in the Austrian niche proves persistently weak.
The service is tightly aligned with the firm's core calculation and compliance support offer, so a medium-sized growing firm would usually keep it while it builds adoption.
It is still close to the established offer and may strengthen the broader data platform, so with current growth and investment the firm is more likely to keep it than redeploy resources immediately.

Custom web services strongly match the firm's software-plus-services model and can be adapted to client needs, which lowers the chance of falling below aspiration for long enough to trigger withdrawal.

Although more generic and easier to replace than the firm's specialist energy products, it can still complement other services and the firm's organisational slack makes immediate withdrawal less likely than continued testing.
